fill.about: HAND-CRAFTED DUMPLINGS, GRILLED MEATS, HIGH SPIRITS, CHILL VIBES. Short for "otsukaresama desu," which roughly translates to "thanks for the hard work," this cozy restaurant and bar next to The Mill & Mine features handcrafted dumplings, small plates, and curated cocktails both traditional and experimental. Come celebrate your wins and relax after a job well done. View Menu GET INTO IT!...
